notes: Two corrections about what the app RECORDS, plus the printed receipt. FIRST, A PRESENTED CHEQUE NOW LEAVES THE MONTH IT ACTUALLY CLEARED IN. The Cheque Register stamped todays date when you ticked an item off, so an officer reconciling July during August recorded the cheque as presented in August — and the July reconciliation went on listing it as unpresented, both live and when the signed-off month was reopened. The register now has a Cleared on date at the top: set it to the statement date you are working through, then tick items off; it applies to Presented and to Credited on lodgements, and defaults to today. Importing a bank statement was always correct. If you have already ticked cheques off on the wrong date, set Cleared on to the right statement date, then Un-present and Presented again — nothing in the ledger moves. SECOND, THE GENERAL LEDGER NAMES THE PAYEE AGAIN. A payment line showed either your narration or Payment to <payee>, never both, so a normal narration like Purchase of stationery left no record of who was paid. Both now appear: Purchase of stationery — Kwarteng Engineering Ltd. Fund receipts do the same with who the money came from. New entries only; posted entries are untouched and the payee is still on the voucher. ALSO IN THIS UPDATE, from 0.6.57/0.8.57: a posted Fund Receipt now prints as an official receipt on your own letterhead with the amount in words and signature lines; Administration, Backup gains Remove passphrase (read the confirmation — removing it does NOT unlock backups already encrypted with it); a project leader now sees only their own projects commitments; and in the multi-company edition each company keeps its own colour in the picker. Nothing to do on upgrade.
